nations.name: Morongo Band of Mission Indians
nations.lands: Morongo Indian Reservation beneath the San Gorgonio Mountains, Riverside County, California

facts.text: Morongo's own history distinguishes an original reservation established in 1865 from the Presidential Executive Order of May 15, 1876.
facts.evidence: On May 15, 1876, the Morongo Indian Reservation was created

facts.text: Morongo records that tribal members began a bingo hall in 1983 and that the Morongo Casino, Resort & Spa opened in late 2004.
facts.evidence: tribal members started a modest bingo hall

facts.text: Morongo's Education Services records that Morongo School opened a new site in September 2010.
facts.evidence: opened its new site in September 2010
